issue: Edit button fully disabled for blocked tasks, preventing any field modification
actual: Clicking the Edit button on a blocked task (e.g. 'Complete tax filing') timed out because the button element has the `disabled` attribute and is not clickable at all. No edit form opens, so description and priority cannot be modified as required, only title/deadline should have been restricted.

evidence: Typing only whitespace into the title field left the 'Create Task' submit button disabled (enabled:false), preventing task creation.

Assigned 'Buy groceries' as prerequisite to both a new task and an existing task (task 1) via the prerequisites checklist in the form; saved task shows blocked state referencing 'Buy groceries' as the incomplete prerequisite.
Tasks with incomplete prerequisites show state='blocked' (distinct from 'active') and their complete toggle has enabled:false, disabling the completion action until prerequisites are done.
Blocked task with 1 incomplete prerequisite shows 'Prerequisite \"X\" incomplete'; blocked task with 2 incomplete prerequisites shows '2 prerequisites incomplete'.

Editing 'Buy groceries' prerequisites list excludes 'Review project proposal v2', 'Complete tax filing', 'Submit final report', 'Plan team offsite' - all tasks that directly or indirectly depend on it - preventing circular dependency selection.

Completing 'Buy groceries' kept it visible in the Completed view (not deleted); it remained available with edit/delete controls and could be reopened via its complete toggle.

issue: Reopening a prerequisite leaves a completed dependent task simultaneously completed and blocked
actual: Completed 'Review project proposal v2' (prerequisite) then completed dependent 'Complete tax filing'. Reopening 'Review project proposal v2' succeeded without restriction, and 'Complete tax filing' remained in the Completed view (count stayed 4, line-through styling retained, complete toggle disabled) while simultaneously showing blocked-warning 'Prerequisite \"Review project proposal v2\" incomplete'. The system neither prevented the reopen nor reverted the dependent task to an incomplete state.

issue: Dependency connector lines are not hoverable (pointer-events disabled)
actual: The dashed dependency connector lines are rendered as SVG `<path>` elements (stroke-dasharray, arrowhead markers) inside an `<svg class="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none z-0">` overlay. Because the overlay has `pointer-events-none`, mouse events pass through the lines entirely, so they cannot be hovered. Directly hovering the small decorative connector div ('.bg-dashed-line') between task cards also produced no tooltip/popup in an isolated test (mouse moved to a neutral element first, then to the connector: no 'Dependency Chain' popup appeared). Only hovering the blocked-task's warning label (a separate element) shows the dependency chain tooltip (see IX-20), not the visual connection line itself.

evidence: Hovering the blocked-warning label on 'Submit final report' opened a tooltip titled 'Dependency Chain' listing 'Review project proposal v2 - pending', 'Buy groceries', and 'Complete tax filing' with status icons, clearly identifying the pending prerequisite in the chain.

Task cards display title (h3) and priority badge always; description paragraph and deadline shown when supplied (e.g. 'Plan team offsite' shows description 'Organize agenda and venue' and deadline 'Sep 15'; 'Organize desk' with no description shows none); blocked tasks show a prerequisite warning; completed tasks are styled with 'line-through text-muted-foreground' class distinguishing them from active tasks which lack that styling.
